stem:
Meena is choosing a cotton shirt to wear to school on a hot summer afternoon in Jaipur.
She wants the shirt that helps her gain the least amount of heat from sunlight.
Which shirt should she choose, and why?

options.text: a black shirt, because dark colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them
a white shirt, because light colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them
a black shirt, because dark colours absorb most of the heat that falls on them
either shirt, because the colour of clothing does not affect how much heat it absorbs

teacher.key_rationale: Light-coloured surfaces reflect most of the heat that falls on them, while dark surfaces absorb more. To gain the least heat in summer, Meena should wear the white (light-coloured) shirt. A is wrong because black absorbs rather than reflects; C correctly states black absorbs but that would make her hotter, so it is not the best choice; D ignores the effect of surface colour.
